origin.note: Springer Lecture Notes in Mathematics 569 (1977), scanned with an OCR text layer. Split page-for-page with pdfseparate/pdfunite; no page was re-rendered or recompressed.
origin.history: The original scan was 351 pages and included a duplicate copy of the Rapport (old PDF pp. 115–148, identical page-for-page to 81–114) inserted right after it. That duplicate has been removed from ../sga4.5.pdf itself (351 → 317 pages); all pdfPages/bookPages below reflect the deduplicated file.

pageOffset.note: Printed book page → PDF page is a uniform +5 throughout (e.g. Expose I p. 4 = PDF p. 9, Expose III p. 110 = PDF p. 115), now that the duplicate block has been removed.

entries.note: Series title page, imprint/copyright page, Deligne's Introduction (2pp), Table des Matières. Only the Introduction becomes a viewer chapter.
